name: water tower (FOUNDED 1625)
notes: Classic six-leg elevated steel tank, pale blue-grey (#A7B8C4), 13 m tank on battered tubular legs with tie-rod X bracing, a balcony at the shell bottom, central riser and a caged ladder. Lettering is real geometry (DejaVu Sans Bold, navy), WESTPORT over FOUNDED 1625, on the front (toward Mariner Drive) and the back. Center is the QA-moved place point (qa.json move_places), which is also the center of Atlas building 57 (kind civic in the Atlas, not "tower"). Leg footings spread to a 16.4 m circle, a little beyond the 12 m Atlas square. Placed 19.5 m back from the centerline of the road beside it (the Atlas point put its legs at the curb), front turned to the road.
